summary: Strong workflow and scripts with pinned action refs, least-privilege permissions, Set-StrictMode, proper error handling, and well-structured pure functions. PowerShell conventions throughout (typed params, splatting, error propagation). Minor: Get-CleanupPlan exceeds typical function length (~120 lines) though logic remains clear. Policies properly factored. Missing test evidence (act-result.txt) and fixtures, but script architecture supports testing well. Workflow references Invoke-Cleanup.ps1 correctly; minor: assumes fixtures/artifacts.json exists but handles gracefully with informative errors.
